title: Securing Grandma's groceries with Pierre Cadieux
description: This content is an interview-style analysis featuring Pierre Cadieux, Research Lead for Intelligence Efficacy at Cisco Talos. It covers his professional journey from early help desk roles in the 1990s to his current position in threat intelligence. The discussion highlights his experience correlating Windows and Unix logs during an intrusion incident involving a vulnerable SSH server, his leadership roles in security, and his philosophy on the human impact of cybersecurity work. The piece emphasizes the importance of understanding the mission behind security efforts and the flexibility Cisco Talos provides to its researchers.
